1. Locate the large arch/dome structure and identify its color. The remaining scattered pixels are "drops" of another color.
2. Determine the columns spanned by the arch (from its leftmost column to its rightmost column).
3. Find every drop located underneath the arch (i.e. within the arch's column span and with a row index below the bottom-most arch pixel in that column).

5. All other pixels (the arch and drops outside/above the arch) remain unchanged.
